name: Lexicographic_to_BigInt_Minimization
description: Replaces the explicit element-by-element lexicographical tie-breaking rule with a requirement to minimize the $n$-digit integer formed by concatenating the sequence of answers. This is mathematically identical to lexicographical minimization but avoids standard terminology, breaking pattern matching for fixed-order backtracking search templates and forcing the model to deduce the correct search strategy from first principles.
